title: PegasusAI Studio: Legible Cyberinfrastructure and Accountable AI Agents for Scientific Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.13309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents can now construct scientific workflows, but operating them on shared cyberinfrastructure (CI) raises problems that code generation does not solve. Agents need current knowledge of the workflow system and its execution sites and access to the runtime state of distributed executions, while facilities need to attribute every agent action to a user and bound it by that user's privileges. We present PegasusAI Studio, an AI-assisted science gateway built on the Pegasus and HTCondor stack. Studio makes CI legible to agents by projecting one facility-curated knowledge base into the native configuration of several coding agents, by introspecting workflow interfaces and execution sites, and by grounding diagnosis in workflow and scheduler telemetry. translated_title: PegasusAI Studio：面向科学工作流的可读性网络基础设施与可问责AI智能体
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体现在能够构建科学工作流，但在共享网络基础设施（CI）上运行这些工作流会带来代码生成本身无法解决的问题。智能体需要掌握工作流系统及其执行站点的最新知识，并能够访问分布式执行的运行时状态；而设施方则需要将每一个智能体操作归因到具体用户，并将其限制在该用户的权限范围内。我们提出了PegasusAI Studio，一个构建于Pegasus和HTCondor技术栈之上的AI辅助科学网关。Studio通过将一个由设施方维护的知识库投射到多种编程智能体的原生配置中、通过内省工作流接口与执行站点、以及通过将诊断建立在工作流和调度器遥测数据之上，使网络基础设施对智能体而言变得“可读”。智能体操作在一个信任包络内运行，该包络结合了联邦身份认证、按用户隔离的执行环境与调度器凭证、供应商中立的模型访问以及可观测性机制。
tldr: PegasusAI Studio通过设施知识库投射、工作流接口内省和遥测数据诊断，使AI编程智能体能够“读懂”共享网络基础设施，并在结合联邦认证与按用户权限的信任包络内安全地构建和运行科学工作流。
en_tdlr: PegasusAI Studio makes shared cyberinfrastructure legible to AI coding agents through facility-curated knowledge bases, workflow introspection, and telemetry-based diagnosis, while safely operating scientific workflows within a trust envelope that combines federated authentication and per-user privileges.
